test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: **Which of the following is NOT true according to the passage?**

options.text: An increase in pH can aggravate certain skin conditions.
The best way to judge the safety of a skin care product is by its pH.
There is no perfect pH for the human skin.
Human skin adjusts the pH so that a cleansing agent functions optimally.

solution: The correct answer is: **The best way to judge the safety of a skin care product is by its pH.**
